summary: Russian forces struck a civilian cargo ship GOLDEN LEO with three X-59/X-69 cruise missiles, killing five and leaving five missing in the Black Sea (Source: @UkraineNow/82777). VSU drones damaged a Tu-95 bomber at Engels-2 airbase in Saratov region, tearing off its tail per satellite imagery (Source: @UkraineNow/82769). Russia launched its largest ballistic missile attack on Kyiv with 42 ballistic and about ten hypersonic missiles (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31744).
key_points: Russian forces hit civilian ship GOLDEN LEO with three X-59/X-69 cruise missiles, killing 5 and leaving 5 missing in Black Sea (Source: @UkraineNow/82777).
SBU drones damaged Tu-95 bomber at Engels-2 airbase in Saratov region, tail torn off per satellite image, drones flew ~800 km (Source: @UkraineNow/82769).
Russia attacked Kyiv with 42 ballistic and about ten hypersonic missiles, largest strike since start of war, warehouses still detonating (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31744).
VSU struck three oil depots in Stavropol region of Russia per UkraineNow main news for July 19 (Source: @UkraineNow/82781).
Russia freed Volnoye in Dnepropetrovsk region per Russian MoD reported by TASS (Source: @tass_agency/385982).
RF forces struck Sumy with seven KABs, three injured hospitalized, one possibly under rubble (Source: @UkraineNow/82763).
RF struck Zaporizhzhia, one dead three injured, five-story building damaged, two under rubble (Source: @UkraineNow/82774).
161 Ukrainian drones intercepted over RF regions and Black Sea per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385985).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces struck civilian cargo ship GOLDEN LEO with three X-59/X-69 cruise missiles killing five with five missing in the Black Sea (Source: @UkraineNow/82777). SBU drones damaged a Tu-95 bomber at Engels-2 airbase in Saratov region tearing off its tail (Source: @UkraineNow/82769). Russia conducted its largest ballistic missile attack on Kyiv with 42 ballistic and about ten hypersonic missiles (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31744).

points: Russian forces struck Sumy with seven KABs, three people injured and hospitalized, at least one person possibly under rubble with rescue ongoing per OVA head Hryhorov (Source: @UkraineNow/82763).

Russian forces attacked Zaporizhzhia, one dead and three injured, five-story building significantly damaged, strikes near nine-story building, two people including woman and child under rubble (Source: @UkraineNow/82774).

Russia attacked Kyiv with the largest number of ballistic missiles for entire full-scale war per UkraineNow July 19 news, also SBU hit three oil depots in Stavropol region (Source: @UkraineNow/82781).
Kyiv was attacked with 42 ballistic missiles and about ten hypersonic missiles plus kamikaze drones, largest blow to Kyiv since start of SMO, warehouses detonating (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31744).
Russian drones attacked a passenger train in Zaporizhzhia region, no deaths, one conductor lightly wounded after Uz monitoring gave evacuation command (Source: @UkraineNow/82763).
Nova Poshta terminal near Kharkiv attacked by Russians, four people died per eRadarrua report (Source: @eRadarrua/101721).
SBU drones struck military airfield Engels-2 in Saratov region, Tu-95 bomber tail torn off per satellite image, drones covered about 800 km to target (Source: @UkraineNow/82769).
SBU units hit three oil depots in Stavropol region of Russia per UkraineNow main news on July 19 (Source: @UkraineNow/82781).
Five people including three children wounded due to VSU drones in Belgorod region per regional opstaff (Source: @tass_agency/385990).
Russia intercepted and destroyed 161 Ukrainian drones over RF regions and Black Sea waters per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385985).
Putin met DPRK foreign minister, sent warmest greetings to Kim Jong Un, praised DPRK military valor in liberating Kursk region (Source: @tass_agency/385975).
Enemy tactical aviation conducted guided bomb launches on Kharkiv region per kpszsu report (Source: @kpszsu/69252).
Russian forces launched KABs on Donetsk region and southeastern direction of Dnipropetrovsk region per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/69258).
Guided aviation bomb launches by enemy tactical aviation on Sumy and Donetsk regions recorded per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/69251).
Reactive drones observed over Kharkiv region toward Berestyn, Slobozhanske, and two toward Krasnopavlivka all reactive per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101713).
Drone toward Kushuhum in Zaporizhzhia from south and toward Tomakivka in Dnipropetrovsk from southeast per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/69230).
Reactive drone over northern Chernihiv region toward or past Snovsk from northwest per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/69248).
Reactive drones near Ripky and two reactive on south Zaporizhzhia course to Mykolaiv region per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101748).
Reactive drones on north Poltava region to Zavodske and Chornukhy per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/69235).
Drone on Poltava region toward or past Velyki Sorochyntsi to Myrhorod per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/69246).
Reactive drones Chernihiv region at Snovsk and Sosnytsia per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101751).
Sumy region reactive drones from northeast toward Mykolaivka/Ulyanivka per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/69231).
Russian forces struck civilian ship GOLDEN LEO with three X-59/X-69 cruise missiles, flag Guinea-Bissau owner Turkey, five dead five missing (Source: @UkraineNow/82777).
Russia hit Odessa port ship with Geran-4, and drone assembly shop with Oniks missiles and loitering munitions per MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385987).
Five GSM reservoirs near Novye Belyary intended for VSU struck per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385977).
Occupied Crimea installing stationary phones for emergencies amid power limits, people told use radio and charging points (Source: @UkraineNow/82765).
Reactive drone past Stepne toward Zaporizhzhia city per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101742).
Two Tu-22 aircraft near southern coast of Crimea per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101723).
Four Tu-22M3 took off from Engels, threat to Odessa within hour per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101712).
Over Crimea: two Su-34, one Su-57, one Su-35 observed, missile launches from Crimea expected on Odessa region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69232).
Elevated threat of X-22/32 from Tu-22M3 within 48 hours for Odessa, Chornomorsk, Pivdenne, Chornomorske per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69246).
X-22 toward Odessa vector Pivdenne-Chornomorske and toward Pivdenne/Koblevo per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69250).
Ballistic missile past Chernihiv to Kyiv and Iskander-M threat from Taganrog Rostov region per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69228).

key_developments: Russian forces hit civilian cargo ship GOLDEN LEO with three X-59/X-69 cruise missiles in Black Sea, five killed five missing, vessel carrying grain (Source: @UkraineNow/82777).
SBU drones damaged Tu-95 bomber at Engels-2 airbase Saratov region, tail torn off, drones traveled about 800 km per satellite imagery (Source: @UkraineNow/82769).
Largest ballistic missile attack on Kyiv: 42 ballistic and about ten hypersonic missiles plus drones, warehouses still detonating (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31744).
VSU struck three oil depots in Stavropol region of Russia per July 19 UkraineNow summary (Source: @UkraineNow/82781).
Russia freed Volnoye in Dnepropetrovsk region per TASS citing MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385982).
Russian forces struck Sumy with seven KABs, three injured, one possibly under rubble, rescue ongoing (Source: @UkraineNow/82763).
161 Ukrainian drones intercepted over RF regions and Black Sea per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385985).
sections.threat_assessment: Russian aviation maintains elevated cruise missile threat against Odessa, Chornomorsk, Pivdenne, and Chornomorske with X-22/32 from Tu-22M3 within 48 hours per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69246). Iskander-M ballistic threat from Taganrog Rostov region was declared by mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69265). Sustained drone and missile strikes on southern ports including GOLDEN LEO and Odessa facilities indicate intent to disrupt grain exports and fuel reserves (Source: @UkraineNow/82777). VSU deep strikes on Engels-2 and Stavropol depots show reciprocal reach into RF strategic assets (Source: @UkraineNow/82769).
sections.regional_response: EU weapon supplier count to Ukraine fell from 21 to 14 with Bulgaria Czech Republic Italy refusing financing and Czech ammo initiative cancelled per Der Spiegel (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31757). Canada promised 35 LAV 6 ACSV armored personnel carriers by year end per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31752). Poland foreign minister stated by 2030 Poland ready to confront Russia alone without NATO (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31738). Kazakhstan condemned drone attacks on civilian ships in Black Sea per TASS (Source: @tass_agency/385982).
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian MoD claims continued strikes on Ukrainian ports and ships including military property warehouse at Pivdennyi port (Source: @tass_agency/385976). Geran-4 used on Chernihiv logistics center and Odessa port ship per MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385959). Ukrainian channel data shows reactive drones across Sumy Poltava Chernihiv Kharkiv Zaporizhzhia Dnipropetrovsk indicating broad dispersal of threats (Source: @kpszsu/69231). SBU satellite-confirmed Tu-95 damage suggests effective long-range drone campaign (Source: @UkraineNow/82769).
